thread:
maria: Quick sync — proposal for 'surgical sampling' on audit exports. Goal: keep full-exports for legal/compliance, but surface compact "surgery" rows in Console and push sampled full snapshots to export bundles. Lower cost but still give investigators the key who/what/when diffs.

maria: High level: 1) UI shows compact change rows (actor, timestamp, changed fields, justification snippet). 2) Admins can request full snapshot for any row (trigger export job). 3) Sampling should bias toward privileged actors, route changes, and rollback events.

tom: Love the approach. Two infra notes: sampled-on-read vs sampled-on-write has different quota/accounting. sampled-on-write saves read-time CPU but increases storage for samples.

sahil: +1 for biasing by privilege. Also we need to be explicit about cryptographic linking: full snapshots must have a proof token so exported bundles can be verified.

jen: UX q: how do we indicate in the Console that a row is 'compact-only' vs 'snapshot-available'? Inline badge? hover tooltip?

maria: Idea: show small badge "compact" and an affordance "Get snapshot" that triggers an export job with a preflight check. Tooltip explains sampling reason (e.g., low-risk auto-sampled).

tom: Implementation debate: should the "Get snapshot" call hit /admin/export/snapshot? Or reuse existing export pipeline with a ?ad-hoc=true flag? Reusing pipeline simplifies delivery guarantees.

sahil: Reuse, but add an arg `sample_origin=compact_ui` to keep telemetry. Example: `POST /v1/exports?snapshot=true&sample_origin=compact_ui` with body {change_id}

maria: +1. Telemetry needs: request_latency, export_size_bytes, export_success, sample_reason (enum), and whether the request was UI-initiated or API-initiated.

jen: Also add a rate-limit/quotas UI hint — ad-hoc snapshot exports can be heavy. We should show the user's remaining ad-hoc export quota and estimated cost before they click.

tom: For quota enforcement: server should check tenant.ad_hoc_quota and queue if over threshold. We should return 202 + job id and show ETA. Avoid blocking UI for long exports.

sahil: Edge case: if compact row was sampled a long time ago, snapshot may no longer be retained. We need TTL hints on the row: "snapshot retention window: 7d".

maria: Agreed. Add TTL text and a small clock icon. Also we should surface justification and linked rollout ID when present — helps triage.

jen: Are we comfortable that compact rows won't leak PII? Need redaction rules for compact view: only surface field names and whether value changed, not actual PII.

sahil: Will require PII classification pass on change payloads. Compact view shows types: "email changed" rather than actual address unless user has export permission.

maria: Permission model: Console view requires view_compact_audit; requesting snapshot requires export_snapshot and export_legal roles. Add a consent modal for snapshots that contain user-identifiable info.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: export-service v2.3 -> staging at 2026-03-22T03:00Z (dry-run) :rocket:

tom: Nice — let's land API shape as: `POST /v1/audit/exports` body: `{ "change_id": "...", "mode": "snapshot|bundle", "sample_origin": "compact_ui|policy_backfill|ingest" }`.

sahil: We should also log `sample_bias_score` in telemetry (0-100) so we can evaluate sampling effectiveness.

jen: For Console: show estimated export time and cost. If cost > X, hide snapshot behind approval flow.

maria: Next actions: tom to prototype API surface + quota checks, sahil to add telemetry events and sample_score, jen to mock Console bits. I'll draft a short RFC and a small product flow diagram.

jen: I'll add a quick Figma screen for the badge + snapshot CTA.

tom: I'll spin up a staging endpoint with the new POST shape and a fake job queue so UX can wire up.

sahil: I'll add telemetry event schema to the metrics proto and add sample_reason enum.

maria: Thanks team. If you hit blockers, drop notes here. We should target a canary in staging next week. :thumbsup:
